senses.gloss:
1. रु रु, ii. 2, Par.
 1. To sound, to make a particular sound, as birds, MBh. 1, 5898; bees, etc., to hum, Hit. i. d. 80, M.M.
 2. To bray, MBh. 1, 4508.
 3. To yelp, Man. 4, 113.
 4. To yell, MBh. 4, 1463.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रुत, n.
 1. Any cry or noise, humming of bees, Bhaṭṭ. 2, 10.
 2. The cry of birds, Lass. 52, 11.
 3. Song, Śāk. d. 131. Frequent. रोरु and रोरूय, To cry loudly, to yelp loudly, MBh. 1, 6112; 663.
 --Caus. रावय, To fill with a roar, MBh. 3, 15928.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिरुत,
 1. Sounded, filled with the sound of, MBh. 3, 1535.
 2. Sounding.
 3. Humming, Śiś. 9, 34. n. Sound, Rām. 1, 9, 17.
 --With आ आ, To cry, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 24.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To sound, Mṛcch. 144, 2.
 2. To yell, Pañc. 64, 4.
 3. To lament, Vikr. d. 102; MBh. 3, 336. विरुत, n. Tone. Śāk. d. 85; singing, Ṛt. 6, 33.
 --Caus. To make a braying noise, Man. 4, 64.
 --With सम् सम्, To cry, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 71.
 --Cf. ὠρύω (frequent.); Lat. raucus, rūmor; A.S. ryn.

† 2. रु रु, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To hurt, or to be angry (?).
 3. To speak.
